sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game puzzle clean background, full bleed portrait 4:5, detailed warm oil/gouache illustration with visible painterly texture, natural coherent light/perspective. Fully opaque RGB: every pixel alpha255, no transparent areas or edge glitches. No writing, logos, digits, identifiable famous place, frame or UI. Complete inviting scene; omit only specified tiny later animated details, leaving natural anchor surfaces. Close cozy three-quarter view of a quiet seaside promenade with two striped deck chairs beside a blue wooden railing, sunlight, pale paving and calm sea. CLEAR SKY BLUE dominates broad sky, water and blue-white chair fabric; varied pleasant detail, colorful flowers near rail. Reserve a small empty cream vase on little round side table, an empty short brass hook beneath a shade rail, a short bare flowering plant stem in pot at left, a blank tie at folded parasol cover on chair, clear distant air above water. Later details small flower, hanging tiny ornament, leaf sprig, ribbon bow, distant gull. No people, words, or landmarks.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Create one professional game-art sprite atlas, transparent RGBA background. Canvas 1536x1024 divided invisibly into 3 columns and 2 rows, five separate complete objects centered in cells 0,1,2,3,4 (row major); cell5 entirely empty. Each object must remain entirely INSIDE its own 512x512 cell with at least 55 pixels EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on all four sides, including stems, shadows, wisps and strings. No outlines, no text, no labels, no ground, no boards, no broad glowing fog; genuine transparency outside the object. High quality softly painted gouache/oil storybook realism, detailed textured brushwork, warm sunlight from upper left, natural colors, no flat vector art. Details will be scaled small and placed into a matching painted puzzle scene. Sunny blue Mediterranean promenade details. Cell0: a white cosmos flower with yellow center and long slim green cut stem to insert into a vase, rootless. Cell1: tiny carved golden wooden fish hanging from a SHORT closed ivory string loop at the very top, complete object with empty margins, no extra hook. Cell2: compact sprig of olive leaves with a short rootless cut stem to join a potted branch. Cell3: small loose ivory cloth ribbon bow with short tails, tied knot in center; no surface. Cell4: small distant white seagull in side profile flying horizontally with complete outstretched wings, softly painted.
